documents.author: Lauren Q. Chen, DO
documents.text:
CARDIOLOGY CONSULTATION - PERIOPERATIVE
Date: 02/20/2026
Reason for consult: perioperative management of anticoagulation ahead of planned carpal tunnel release.

HPI: Patient with persistent atrial fibrillation (CHA2DS2-VASc 2, HAS-BLED 2) maintained on Xarelto 20 mg PO daily with evening meal. No history of major bleeding. No stroke or TIA. Reports good adherence. Rate well controlled on current regimen.

Renal function: creatinine 1.25 mg/dL, estimated CrCl 101 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault).
ECG: sinus rhythm, rate 68, no acute ST changes.
Echo (last year): LVEF 60%, no significant valvular disease.
RCRI: 1. Functional capacity >4 METs.

ASSESSMENT: Acceptable cardiac risk for the planned procedure. Bleeding risk of the procedure considered low-to-moderate. Thromboembolic risk low; bridging not indicated for DOAC therapy.

RECOMMENDATIONS:
  1. Hold Xarelto for the 2 days before surgery (last dose 02/26/2026; no doses in the 48 hours prior). Resume Xarelto 24-48 hours after surgery once hemostasis is secure, per surgical team.
  2. Continue atorvastatin through the perioperative period.
  3. No further cardiac testing required prior to surgery.
  4. Please call with questions.

SOCIAL HISTORY: Never smoker. Retired teacher.
